report.model_summary: Reported PMPM fell from $131.31 to $97.21 (-$34.10), but the correct PMPM rose from $131.31 to $177.95 (+$46.64). Numerator costs genuinely grew from $1,269,800 to $1,720,800 (+$451,000) as pending claims adjudicated to paid. The denominator query double-counted members after the rebuild added pharmacy rows (17,702 rows vs 9,670 distinct member-months), understating PMPM by $80.74. Do not report as a program win.
